title: An address translator
description:
Translate virtual addresses to physical ones with a page table.

```
page size 4096
virtual 0x1A2C -> page 1, offset 0xA2C -> frame 7 -> physical 0x7A2C
virtual 0x5000 -> page 5 not present: page fault
```
hints: The physical address is `frame * PAGE_SIZE + offset` (lesson 6.03).
With a page size that is a power of two, the offset is also `address & (PAGE_SIZE - 1)`, which is what the hardware does.
requirements: A page table is a dictionary from page number to frame number.
The page is `address // page_size` and the offset `address % page_size`.
Missing pages are page faults; count them.
stretch: Load a missing page into a free frame on a fault, and throw out the oldest page when no frame is free.
